He didn’t provide further details.”.

On 2026-09-08, Al Jazeera reported “Saudi Arabia has accused Yemen’s Houthi rebels of launching attacks on civilian and economic sites in the kingdom, wounding at least 73 civilians, including women and children.”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “At least 73 civilians are wounded in Houthi strikes on cities and economic infrastructure in southern Saudi Arabia”.

On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “Al-Malki said the attacks wounded 73 people, including women and children.”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “At least 73 civilians are wounded in Houthi strikes on cities and economic infrastructure in southern Saudi Arabia”.

On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “Al-Malki said the attacks wounded 73 people, including women and children.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “Al-Malki said the attacks wounded 73 people, including women and children. He didn’t provide further details.”.

On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “The Iranian-backed Houthi rebel group in Yemen launched a wave of attacks on Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, wounding more than 70 people and igniting fires at oil facilities and utilities in the kingdom, authorities said.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “Attacks on Saudi Arabia Tuesday claimed by Yemen's Houthis wounded more than 70 people and ignited fires at several oil facilities and utilities in the kingdom's southern region, authorities said, in a major escalation in the renewed conflict between an important US ally and the Iranian-backed rebels.”.

On 2026-09-08, NPR reported “The civil war has killed at least 150,000 people, according to U.N. estimates, and at times pushed the country to the brink of famine.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “The civil war has killed at least 150,000 people, according to UN estimates, and at times pushed the country to the brink of famine.”.

On 2026-09-08, NPR reported “The attacks ignited fires at several oil facilities and utilities in Saudi Arabia's southern region, the kingdom's Energy Ministry said in a statement.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “The attacks ignited fires at several oil facilities and utilities in Saudi Arabia’s southern region, the kingdom’s energy ministry said in a statement.
